intro.line: Kaladesh, the plane of inventors, where aether powers everything. The Inventors' Fair is about to open.
Never before have there been so many brilliant minds and wondrous inventions in one place. Denizens from every corner of Kaladesh will flock to the once-in-a-lifetime Inventors' Fair.
Chandra Nalaar has come home. The last time she was here, the Consulate took her father.
Baral took my family from me back then. I'd do anything to face him now.

finale.line: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.
You want to know what we are fighting for? Look at the wonder in that child's eyes.
Until all have found their place, I will keep watch.
The bridge is broken. Tezzeret is gone, and so is whoever he was working for.

villainFinale.line: It is finished. Now the real work can begin.
You can't hope to comprehend the plans that are in motion.

battles.title: The Fairgrounds
battles.blurb: You arrive in Ghirapur as the Inventors' Fair opens. Chandra Nalaar is home for the first time in years, and Consulate guards are watching every gate.

scene.line: Welcome, one and all! Right this way! Open your eyes, your ears, and your imaginations to the wonders of the Inventors' Fair!
This one's for my mom, and this one's for me.
Energy: some cards give you energy counters. Save them up and spend them on bigger effects later.

villainScene.line: All skyships entering or leaving the fairgrounds must pass through the security checkpoint.
Citizens are free to do as they wish, within the confines of the Consulate's laws.

battles.title: The Leaking Spire
battles.blurb: Pia Nalaar, Chandra's mother, runs with the renegades. Kari Zev and her skyship crew ride with them against Gonti's smugglers.

scene.line: To invent is to rebel.
Aboard her ship, the *Dragon's Smile*, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.
Vehicles: they are artifacts that only fight once you crew them, by tapping creatures with enough total power. Crew, then attack.

villainScene.line: I am confident that all our enterprises can benefit from this little revolution.
Renegades do some of their best work right under the Consulate's nose.

battles.title: The Exhibition
battles.blurb: Saheeli Rai shows her filigree creations at the Fair. Consul Padeem judges them, and he wants them under Consulate control.

scene.line: Our creations are more than mere things. They have life in them, little bits of ourselves.
From the first touch, I know exactly what the metal wants to be.
Fabricate: when it enters, choose. Put +1/+1 counters on it, or make that many 1/1 Servos instead.

battles.title: Chief of Compliance
battles.blurb: Baral, the man who killed Chandra's father, sets a trap for her. She walks into it anyway.

scene.line: Chandra was driven by her anger, directed particularly at the man who had taken her father from her.
We meet again, pyromancer.
Improvise: his spells can tap his artifacts to help pay. Count his artifacts before you count his mana.

villainScene.line: The echo of silence is music to my ears.
How easily your flames are quenched.

hero.half: Make him counter something small first.

battles.title: The Great Conduit
battles.blurb: Rashmi, an aether-seer, is helping the renegades. Dovin Baan, the Consulate's fair-minded inquirer, is following the trail.

scene.line: I opened my mind to the immensity of the wonders around me. It was only then that I could see the Great Conduit.
The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.
Revolt: these cards get better if a permanent of yours left the battlefield this turn. Sacrifice a Clue or a Map first.

villainScene.line: Too much friction on your bearings, your countersinking is inconsistent, and there are lines in your casting. Dispose of it, and begin again.
Give me eight walkers, I'll give you the city.

battles.title: Energy and Counters
battles.blurb: A tribute to Standard in early 2017: red-green Energy against black-green Winding Constrictor counters.

scene.line: It won't be small forever.
It's natural, it's all around us, and it's there for the taking. Just try and tell me what I'm doing is wrong.
Their counters grow every turn. Race them before the Constrictor gets going.

villainScene.line: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

battles.title: Heart of Kiran
battles.blurb: A tribute to Standard in early 2017: Mardu Vehicles against the Aetherworks Marvel.

deck.name: Aetherworks Marvel
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: He's set to compete in every race at the Fair, and he plans to win them all.
If you wish to produce the finest work, you must start with the finest tools.
Crew: tap creatures to turn a vehicle on. Keep enough power around to crew every turn.

villainScene.line: If nothing else, the Inventors' Fair taught us that we're only beginning to discover aether's true potential.

battles.title: The Planar Bridge
battles.blurb: Tezzeret runs the Consulate and the Fair, and he has built a Planar Bridge for someone. The Gatewatch and the renegades storm the Aether Spire.

scene.line: This is about more than aether or inventions. Tezzeret's schemes must be stopped!
With spy thopters all around, how can the consuls be so blind to Tezzeret's manipulations?
He draws and he builds. Make him use his cards on your creatures, not on his own plans.

villainScene.line: This is bigger than you. All of you.
Too little, too late. The machine is in motion.

half.line: The disruptor thopter is away! Keep him busy!

battles.title: Copycat
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, the cat that copied itself.

archive.what: Decks built around Saheeli Rai and Felidar Guardian. The Guardian blinks Saheeli, Saheeli copies the Guardian, and the copies repeat until there are endless hasty cats.
archive.why: Any deck that let the two land together could lose on the spot. The combo pieces also fit neatly into Energy decks.
archive.beat: Pressure them hard and kill Saheeli as soon as she lands.
archive.after: Felidar Guardian was banned in Standard in April 2017. Forge's CPU rarely assembles the combo, so this tribute mostly plays fair.

deck.name: Copycat
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: The loyalty of a felidar is hard won but worth the effort.
If the cat and the inventor ever meet, it is over. Keep the pressure on.

villainScene.line: From the first touch, I know exactly what the metal wants to be.

after.line: Recorded: Felidar Guardian banned in Standard, April 2017.
